title_ko: 직무 요구–자원 모형(JD-R) — 번아웃과 몰입을 한 틀로 보기
title_en: Job Demands–Resources (JD-R) — one frame for burnout and engagement
gist: Job features split into demands (workload, emotional labor, irregular schedules) and resources (autonomy, support, feedback, growth). Demands drive exhaustion, resources drive engagement, and resources buffer high demands.
source: Bakker & Demerouti (2007), Journal of Managerial Psychology 22(3)

title_ko: 직무 배태성(Job Embeddedness) — 사람들은 왜 남는가
gist: Instead of asking why people leave, it asks why they stay: links to the organization and community, fit with the job, and what they would sacrifice by leaving predict lower voluntary turnover.
source: Mitchell, Holtom, Lee, Sablynski & Erez (2001), Academy of Management Journal 44(6)

title_ko: 자발적 이직의 전개 모형 — 퇴사는 '충격'에서 시작된다
title_en: The unfolding model of voluntary turnover — quitting often starts with a shock
gist: Many resignations are not the end of slowly growing dissatisfaction. A specific event (a shock) makes the person re-evaluate the job, and people follow a few distinct decision paths, some without ever searching for alternatives.
source: Lee & Mitchell (1994), Academy of Management Review 19(1)

title_ko: 신규 입사자 조직사회화 — 초기 적응이 근속을 좌우한다
gist: A meta-analysis of newcomer adjustment: role clarity, self-efficacy and social acceptance in the first months link onboarding tactics and newcomer information seeking to later performance, satisfaction, commitment and turnover.
source: Bauer, Bodner, Erdogan, Truxillo & Tucker (2007), Journal of Applied Psychology 92(3)

title_ko: 서비스–수익 사슬 — 직원 만족이 고객 충성과 수익으로 이어지는 경로
title_en: The service-profit chain — from employee satisfaction to customer loyalty and profit
gist: Profit and growth come from loyal customers; loyalty comes from customer satisfaction and service value; value is created by satisfied, loyal and productive employees, which depends on internal service quality.
source: Heskett, Jones, Loveman, Sasser & Schlesinger, Harvard Business Review

title_ko: 좋은 일자리 전략 — 매장 인력에 투자하는 리테일이 이기는 이유
title_en: The Good Jobs Strategy — why investing in store staff pays off for retailers
gist: Retailers that invest in store employees (stable schedules, training, adequate staffing levels) and pair it with operational choices such as simplification and cross-training can achieve both low costs and strong service, instead of treating labor only as a cost to minimize.

title_ko: 심리적 안전감 — 말해도 괜찮다는 믿음이 팀 학습을 만든다
title_en: Psychological safety — the shared belief that it is safe to speak up
gist: Team psychological safety is a shared belief that the team is safe for interpersonal risk taking. It predicts learning behavior (asking for help, admitting errors, giving feedback), which in turn predicts team performance.

title_ko: 이직과 성과 — 이직률은 조직 성과를 얼마나 깎는가
title_en: Turnover and performance — how much employee turnover costs firm performance
gist: A meta-analytic review of employee turnover as a predictor of firm performance: on average higher turnover is associated with lower performance, with the strength of the relationship varying by context such as industry, type of turnover and performance measure.
source: Hancock, Allen, Bosco, McDaniel & Pierce (2013), Journal of Management 39(3)

title_ko: 감정 노동 — 표면 행위와 내면 행위
title_en: Emotional labor — surface acting and deep acting
gist: Service employees regulate emotions to meet display rules. Surface acting (faking the expression) and deep acting (changing the felt emotion) have different consequences for strain, burnout and service performance.
source: Grandey (2000), Journal of Occupational Health Psychology 5(1)

title_ko: 현실적 직무 소개(RJP) — 채용 때 좋은 점만 말하지 않기
title_en: Realistic job previews — telling candidates the hard parts too
gist: Giving candidates a balanced picture of the job, including its difficult aspects, before they accept is associated with somewhat lower early turnover and more accurate initial expectations. Effects depend on timing and medium.
